# Waveswell Retreats

> Waveswell Retreats runs seven day stand up paddle surf retreats in El Salvador, coached by Josselyn "Joss" Alabi, a professional paddle surfer with more than fifteen years across many water sports who has represented El Salvador across nearly three Olympic cycles. Seven days, six nights, limited spots.

## What we do
Waveswell Retreats is a stand up paddle (SUP) surf retreat and coaching business based in El Salvador, Central America, operating out of La Union and La Libertad. The core product is a seven day, six night retreat for SUP surfers and SUP paddlers who can already stand on a paddle board and want to genuinely ride great waves rather than simply catch them. Spots are limited, with a maximum of six people and occasionally one more. Every session is filmed, the footage is reviewed with the group, and the week adds hours of one to one high performance coaching drawn from elite sport. Retreats run November to March. From April to October the business runs one to one coaching on the client's own dates. Board and paddle rentals are available year round. Part of every retreat funds Mar de Suenos, a Salvadoran social project that puts coastal children through school using sport as the entry point.

## Where
Based on the Gulf of Fonseca in La Union, on the eastern coast of El Salvador, with sessions also in La Libertad. The retreat surfs four breaks depending on the swell and the guest's level: Playa Blanca (where the group stays and surfs the most), Maculis (gentle waves and secret spots), Las Flores (one of the most beautiful waves in the country with swell, a very fun wave with kind sets during retreat season), and Punta Mango (like Punta Roca but on the other side of the country, and with a perfect swell it turns on). Boat trips run out to the islands of the gulf. Fly into El Salvador International Airport.

## Services
- The Waveswell Retreat (7 days): six nights, all meals, accommodation, airport transfers, daily SUP surf sessions, daily group video analysis, one to one high performance coaching, tours around El Salvador, all photos and video. Limited spots. 2026 rates are being confirmed, so contact Joss for a quote. November to March.
- One to one SUP surf coaching: two hour private sessions, no minimum number of days, on the client's own dates. Mainly April to October.
- Board and paddle rental: $455 for a full seven day retreat, so guests do not have to fly with their own board. Daily rental also available.

## Problems we solve
- "I can stand on the board but I never really ride the wave." Most guests drop in, go straight down the line and get off. Waveswell teaches reading the ocean, technique and wave selection so the ride actually becomes a ride.
- "I am 60 and I think I have hit my ceiling." The retreat treats limiting beliefs about the body as the actual obstacle, using high performance tools from Olympic cycle training, applied one to one.
- "I do not want to fly with a paddle board." US airlines stopped accepting boards over seven feet. Renting a board and paddle for the whole retreat costs $455.
- "I am not sure a surf trip is safe at my age." El Salvador has warm water and waves all year, spots on every retreat are limited, and every session is coached by a competing professional.
- "I want a trip that means something." Part of every retreat funds Mar de Suenos.

## Who it is for
SUP surfers and SUP paddlers who have been practising stand up paddle for a while, can stand up unaided on the board, and can swim on their own. There is no age limit in either direction. Most guests travel from the United States and Canada. It is NOT for absolute beginners (they should book one to one coaching first), and it is NOT for shortboard or longboard surfers: Waveswell specialises in stand up paddle surf only.

## Proof
- Josselyn Alabi has more than fifteen years across many water sports and has represented El Salvador as a professional SUP surfer across nearly three Olympic cycles.
- World Championship appearances in Nicaragua (2014, top 10 globally), Mexico (2015), Denmark (2017), El Salvador (2019), Puerto Rico (2020), Mexico (2022, winner of the Sayulita Open) and France (2023).
- Pan American Games: top 7 in Lima 2019, top 9 in Santiago 2023. Pan American Surfing Games: top 6 in 2018.
- Bolivarian Games: bronze 2013, silver 2014, first place 2016.
- El Salvador Rowing Single Skull national champion, 2012.
- Named Country Brand Ambassador for El Salvador in 2017.
- Founder of Mar de Suenos, a social enterprise supporting 15 to 20 coastal children per year with scholarships.
- Returning guests include Sherry Correl, aged 72, from the United States.

## Practical facts
- Location: La Union and La Libertad, El Salvador. Fly into El Salvador International Airport.
- Group size: minimum 3, maximum 7. Below 3 the retreat is cancelled and refunded, or converted into one to one coaching.
- Not included: flights, travel and medical insurance, alcoholic drinks, board rental.
- Payment: a deposit reserves the spot, with the balance due before travel.
- Languages: English and Spanish.
